status: Read-only official-interface research; design recommendation, not implemented or experimentally verified management.

versionBoundary.checkedNow: Both package.json version and SHA match the prior public-package records. This does not prove runtime method behavior and is not permission to pin a binary/version. Different registered official entry must advertise/negotiate or reject unsupported.
versionBoundary.onlineDocs: Current online documentation is not versioned to this installed package; tagged code owns exact wire/behavior. Docs path-only skills example omits supported name alternative; perCwdExtraUserRoots online example is absent from tag SkillsListParams.
versionBoundary.tagCommitResolution: Not claimed: tree API returns a tree SHA, not commit identity; a later tag-ref read was rate-limited (HTTP403). Exact tag URLs plus downloaded-file SHA identify inspected source.

params.path: <absolute exact skill document path; omit name>

skillsConfigWrite.alternateSelector: Exactly one path OR nonempty trimmed name; both/neither invalid. Name affects every loaded same-name skill, so not appropriate for single-row UI authority.

response.effectiveEnabled: boolean: implementation returns the requested value, without verifying effective enablement

skillsConfigWrite.writeScope: The handler writes effective CODEX_HOME/config.toml via ConfigEditsBuilder::new; not repo .codex, admin/system skill files, plugin manifest, or chosen cwd config. No filePath, expectedVersion, cwd, per-session target or operation nonce parameter.
skillsConfigWrite.disable: Updates first matching selector or appends enabled=false; canonicalizes path when possible. Does not delete skill content.
skillsConfigWrite.enable: Removes first matching override, not explicit enabled=true. Remaining duplicate/name/SessionFlags rules can still disable the skill; no matching selector can return success without changing disk.
skillsConfigWrite.applicability: The override engine applies to merged loaded paths without filtering user/repo/system/admin/plugin scope; scope is origin, not write destination. Bundled-disabled, plugin-disabled, omitted/failed roots may not yield a skill to enable. This is not permission to enable an entire plugin or override administrator policy.

shapeRisk.classification: Concrete source-path risk; not a reproduced CLI/API failure in this task
shapeRisk.finding: set_skill_config accepts only toml_edit ArrayOfTables. A parsed inline skills.config=[{...}] follows the non-ArrayOfTables branch: enabled=false replaces the existing array before adding target; enabled=true returns without mutation. Thus unrelated rules may be lost or enabling may no-op. Existing three upstream examples cover only [[skills.config]].
shapeRisk.requiredProof: Use self-owned config containing two valid inline entries and a distinct target; compare full semantic config before/after official call. Do not execute against user config, patch upstream, or infer safety from success response.

skillsConfigWrite.writeMechanics: Follows existing symlink resolution, reads full TOML, applies edits, then writes sibling temporary file and persists. Atomic replacement does not mean atomic compare-and-swap or power-loss durability; no explicit fsync in helper. Broken/cyclic symlink handling has fallback behavior and needs an owned fixture.
skillsConfigWrite.concurrency: Method declares global config serialization within one server. Other CLI/server/editor writers are outside that serialization; official read-edit-persist path has no external lock or expected version.
skillsConfigWrite.failureUnknown: Parse/write errors return internal error. After dispatch, lost response/cancellation/process exit is not proof no config changed. Do not auto-retry or auto-restore old config. Explicit fresh official read is the recovery action.
skillsConfigWrite.readback: After writing, explicit skills/list {cwds:[exactOriginalCwd],forceReload:true} reloads config, invalidates caches and reports current enabled per exact path. Incomplete/errors, absent target or mismatched state remain unresolved/overridden, not enabled success.
skillsConfigWrite.currentConversation: Dedicated handler only clears managers; it does not request existing Farfold ACP sessions to reload. Readback in an isolated management process proves its report, not current model use. No automatic restart, resume, send or current-session config change is proposed.

saferOfficialAlternative.assessment: Preferred candidate for a controlled management implementation: official exact-key, version-checked user-layer edit. Requires owned integration proof; not a claim of full cross-process isolation.
saferOfficialAlternative.capture: Keep exact active User layer path/version and complete skills.config array only in restricted RAM. The API can return unrelated sensitive config; never forward/log the raw response. Validate/bound full response, extract minimal allowlist, then discard unrelated values. No direct private-file parser.

params.value: <complete prior USER array, preserving every other entry and order; append or precisely replace selected canonical path rule enabled=true/false>
params.filePath: <exact active User layer path from config/read>

saferOfficialAlternative.arraySemantics: This key is an array, not an indexed path; do not invent skills.config.N.enabled. Remove only duplicate rules for the exact selected path if the approved diff explicitly shows this; do not remove same-name or unrelated rules. Prefer an appended path rule after preserved rules to disambiguate name precedence; reject ambiguous/unrecognized entries instead of silently normalizing.

response.overriddenMetadata: nullable message/layer/effectiveValue; keep private and render sanitized reason

saferOfficialAlternative.scope: Only allowed user config path is accepted even though filePath exists. No repository-write selector. Config validation rejects managed exact requirements. The response override calculation is thread-agnostic and cannot prove selected repo or separate session behavior.
saferOfficialAlternative.expectedVersionProtection: Rejects a user layer changed before the method reload/check. Same-server global config serialization applies. An external edit after that check is not rechecked atomically at persist: ConfigEditsBuilder rereads then applies SetPath. This reduces stale writes but is not a global CAS guarantee or a reason to declare development impossible.
saferOfficialAlternative.preservation: Official SetPath changes only skills.config, preserving other keys structurally in the later disk document. Within the array, Farfold must pass every prior non-target rule exactly. External concurrent edits to this same array after check may still be overwritten; later full official readback must compare intended array and unrelated semantic config without leaking it.
saferOfficialAlternative.representationInterop: The generic writer serializes arrays as TOML inline arrays (configService:701-738). Mixing later dedicated skills/config/write with that representation may hit its shape risk. Owned tests must cover both directions; no silent switch back to dedicated method or claim that all other official clients are safe.
saferOfficialAlternative.batchAlternative: config/batchWrite uses edits[{keyPath,value,mergeStrategy}], same filePath/expectedVersion; optional reloadUserConfig reloads some settings of loaded threads in this same server. Do not request broad reload for this first slice or use it as evidence about separate ACP connections.
saferOfficialAlternative.readback: Read config again with exact cwd/layers and compare user-layer intended change; then skills/list forceReload. A successful write with ineffective enabled state must remain distinct. The returned write version is based on calculated layers, not a subsequent filesystem reread.

add.parameters: mcp add NAME (--url URL | -- COMMAND...) ; stdio optional --env KEY=VALUE; HTTP --bearer-token-env-var, --oauth-client-id, --oauth-client-registration auto|cimd|dcr, --oauth-resource. No explicit scope, dry-run or skip-login option in this tag.
add.destination: Loads global user MCP map, inserts/replaces the exact name with a default-enabled entry, writes entire mcp_servers map via user config.
add.partialCommit: HTTP add discovers OAuth then persists configuration before automatic OAuth browser flow. Nonzero exit/timeout/cancel during login can leave configuration added. Do not say not-added or auto-remove rollback.
add.concurrentRisk: replace_mcp_servers deletes keys absent from its earlier snapshot even though the file is read again; can lose concurrent same-table additions. Config atomic replacement does not cure stale map replacement.

remove.result: Removes only global user entry, succeeds also when name absent; textual stdout, no structured mutation receipt. Not disable, logout, revocation, plugin removal or confirmation of current tool disconnection. Other config/plugin sources may still provide the server.

narrowerConfigRoute.boundary: Prospective configured-only management: no connect/login as side effect of this request. Verify actual behavior in controlled official process; disabled creation is intentional until separate explicit connection. Keys with dot/quote/backslash require protocol keyPath quoting, not concatenation. Existing same-name effective entry may come from repo/plugin; do not overwrite/remove on ambiguous provenance. No arbitrary secrets in command args/logs.

login.cli: mcp login NAME [--no-browser] [--scopes comma,list] [--oauth-client-registration auto|cimd|dcr]. Streamable HTTP only; effective server lookup; configured header helper/runtime and external OAuth may have side effects.

params.name: <exact configured server>
params.threadId: <optional same-server loaded thread; omit for first management scope>

login.reply: authorizationUrl starts authentication, not success. Later mcpServer/oauthLogin/completed {name,threadId,success,error?} is completion; no independent operation identifier in notification.
login.credentials: Official code writes its selected keyring or CODEX_HOME/.credentials.json fallback. Token success is saved before completion. File fallback uses aggregate store lock and regular-file/no-follow guard, then truncates+writes in place; not the config-file atomic rename. Config and credential updates are not one transaction.
login.cancel: No dedicated MCP OAuth cancel method found in this tagged request registry; closing UI or stopping a local process cannot prove remote auth grant/token revocation. Late completion and timeout stay explicit unknown until official evidence. Do not misuse account/login cancel or mcp logout as rollback.
login.scope: One exact owner/server attempt per managed process; notification name/threadId alone cannot disambiguate concurrent repeated login attempts. Farfold must retain process/request ownership and not publish late completion into another attempt.

mcpManagement.reloadAndDiagnosis: config/mcpServer/reload {} acts on threads loaded in that management server only. mcpServerStatus/list can initialize/connect configured servers and must be a separately explicit diagnostic operation, not reused as passive P39 inventory. Neither proves separate Farfold ACP session reload. Return {} means refresh requested/applied config path, not all tools callable.
mcpManagement.notYetProven: No CLI mutation, OAuth account flow, secret-store behavior, live tool call, rollback, Windows, or installed management UI was executed. First MCP slice can be exact user entry disable/add-disabled with official config write and readback; connect/login/diagnosis remain separate required P41 work.

recommendedFirstSlice.name: P40 existing skill exact-path user preference, official read → explicit approve → version-checked exact-key write → fresh report
recommendedFirstSlice.deliverable: A reversible user-layer enabled/disabled preference for an already-discovered user/repo skill. No file copying/deletion, install, plugin enablement, scope migration, automatic model request or configuration patch outside official API.
recommendedFirstSlice.managementAuthority: P39 public ordinal/name is presentation only. Current projection discards private path; extend a separate bounded opaque RAM management ticket containing exact reviewed Agent row/selection, cwd identity, private skill path/origin/plugin identity, observed state and user-layer version. Capability alone or stale public row cannot authorize write.
recommendedFirstSlice.supportedStart: Start with non-plugin user/repo paths. System/admin/plugin entries remain visible but management unavailable until separately proven policy semantics. This is a staged scope, not P40 completion or contractual exclusion.
recommendedFirstSlice.confirmation: Show skill/origin, requested change, user-configuration scope across directories where that path is discovered, no content deletion and no guaranteed current-conversation effect. Selection/Agent/cwd/version drift withdraws permission; one explicit action, no auto-retry.
recommendedFirstSlice.lifecycle: Before dispatch, cancellation means no write only if dispatch never happened. After dispatch, close/cancel preserves unknown and exact owner until worker termination and explicit official readback; never convert timeout to not-written or restore old config automatically. Serialize Farfold writes; external-process race limitation stays explicit.
recommendedFirstSlice.successBar: Official write response accepted AND fresh official config shows intended target-only user rule change AND skills/list reports desired enabled for the same target. Distinguish not-effective/changed/conflict/unknown. Readback is configuration/report verification; actual new-conversation adoption needs a separately authorized real-Agent test.
recommendedFirstSlice.candidateRoute: Prefer config/value/write exact skills.config array with expectedVersion after owned interoperability tests. Dedicated skills/config/write has concrete shape/echo risks and is not a safe blind fallback. External all-process isolation is not a prerequisite promise.
recommendedFirstSlice.implementationOwnershipSuggestion: Backend official process/protocol and private ticket in acp_client; shared capability-driven controller/types and existing Agent details UI. No agent-specific visible panel, new config store, model executor or direct private-file writes.
recommendedFirstSlice.remainingContract: P40 discovery/install and broader scope management, P41 arbitrary server connect/auth/diagnostics, full P39 tool availability/current-conversation applicability, other Agents and Windows remain unfinished.

requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.sample: Two distinct AoT rules; equivalent valid inline array; two same-name paths; duplicate selector; preserve unrelated rule order and unrelated config keys. Test dedicated and generic writer separately and their subsequent interoperability.
requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.expected: No unrelated rule lost; reported enabled must be freshly true/false as intended, not echoed return. Any observed upstream limitation retained.

requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.sample: User name-disable plus selected path rule; SessionFlags disable; repo/admin skill origin; plugin disabled/missing; bundled disabled.
requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.expected: Exact user preference effect and scope labeled; desired state overridden/not discoverable does not count success. No plugin/config-layer change inferred.

requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.sample: Change user config before expectedVersion check; then controlled barrier edit between version check/read/persist using a self-owned process fixture.
requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.expected: Stale precheck rejected; prove actual within-server serialization; record external remaining race rather than claiming global CAS. No blind automatic retry.

requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.sample: Malformed/readonly config, broken/cyclic symlink fixture, terminate/drop reply before versus after write, failed postwrite readback.
requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.expected: Original data retained where officially rejected; unknown after possible write remains unknown; explicit readback can resolve without rollback or model prompt.

requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.sample: Agent A→B→A, cwd replacement, fresh list with reordered duplicate names, close/reopen, expired ticket, late result after another operation.
requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.expected: No stale row/ordinal write authority, one confirmed dispatch, no auto query or publication to another owner.

requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.sample: Add configured row then controlled OAuth failure; remove missing and layered same-name; config key containing punctuation; unrelated simultaneous table edit.
requiredControlledProofsBeforeRelease.expected: Separate configured/authenticated/connected/tool-usable evidence; no success by exit alone, no silent replace or automatic remove rollback.
